documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: In the Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, Uniparts India reported a 27% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 347 crores, EBITDA growth of 55% to INR 90 crores, and PAT growth of 64% to INR 57 crores. Growth was supported by strong performance in the construction equipment segment, which comprised 45% of total revenue during the quarter. The company maintained a robust trailing 12-month new business order book of over INR 225 crores and rebuilt its net cash balance to INR 190 crores. Management guided for full-year FY27 revenue growth to exceed FY26 levels by a couple of percentage points, with Q2 FY27 performance expected to remain robust in line with Q1. Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 27% YoY, EBITDA growth of 55% YoY, and PAT growth of 64% YoY.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 revenue growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26 year-on-year growth.
guidance.quote: keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q2 FY27 performance to remain robust and in line with Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: Management targets maintaining EBITDA margins of around 20% over a peak-to-trough cycle.
guidance.quote: So Mr. Jain, when we talk about 20% margins, we are talking about 20% margins over a cycle which is peak to trough.

guidance.claim: The company expects first customer deliveries from its Mexico warehouse in Q3 FY27.
guidance.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

guidance.claim: Uniparts India stated that its Q1 FY27 performance aligned with its quarter-on-quarter guidance and exceeded its annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 growth to be in line with FY26 growth.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: Sequentially, Q1 FY27 performance is expected to be in line with Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

guidance.claim: The company expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of FY27.
guidance.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

guidance.claim: Management considers 20% EBITDA margin sustainable over the cycle and expects to operate comfortably above that level in FY27.
guidance.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment segment momentum continued into Q1 FY27, supported by technology investments in the U.S. and government spending in Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment conditions remain subdued, with 2026 seen as the cyclical bottom and recovery expected through calendar year 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture equipment in India continues to perform well, driven by government subsidy programs and higher adoption across mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket revenue represented approximately 12% of Q1 FY27 revenue and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure investments in the US and government spending in Europe are driving healthy customer schedules and order visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture segment growth in Western markets remains measured due to economic uncertainty.
demand_outlook.quote: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicate CY2026 as the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, expecting recovery through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: North American construction equipment demand is expected to strengthen gradually through FY27, with the second half better than the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is expected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Europe's small agriculture market outlook for FY27 is positive with modest growth anticipated.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the outlook for FY27 is positive with modest growth anticipation.

demand_outlook.claim: Large tractor industry volumes in North America continue to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year, while European sentiment is gradually improving.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year. However, in Europe, the sentiment is gradually improving.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket sector continues to be a stable contributor for Uniparts across North America and Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: We also have the aftermarket sector, and the aftermarket continues to be a stable contributor for Uniparts across North America and Europe.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 12 crores, focused on capacity enhancement and productivity improvement.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule without customer supply disruption.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track, with initial warehouse deliveries expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex stood at INR 12 crores for Q4 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at approximately 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Efforts are underway to rebuild the Ludhiana plant's finishing shop and bring it online by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: Right. So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 90 crores, representing a 55% year-on-year and 10% sequential increase.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains that its material costs typically range between 34% and 37%.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: Warehouse sales represent the highest margin delivery channel compared to direct exports and local sales.
margins_costs.quote: And then the warehouse sales is our highest margin product.

margins_costs.claim: The West Asia situation continues to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts reported an EBITDA margin of 24% in Q4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Freight and raw material costs are direct pass-throughs to customers.
margins_costs.quote: And I think as far as we are concerned, the freight and the raw material component of the cost is a direct pass-through to customers, right?

margins_costs.claim: Material cost in Q4 FY26 was 35%, returning to the standard range of 34% to 37%.
margins_costs.quote: Now when we look at quarter 4 and let's understand the results of quarter 4, our material cost of 35% has now come back to where we've always said our normal material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%.

margins_costs.claim: The new wage code introduced in November 2025 caused an INR 3.4 crore impact on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The construction equipment segment generated 45% of total revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Ashutosh, you are right that in Q1 FY27, the business has really seen a good growth in the construction business, which is today 45% of our total revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Warehousing sales accounted for approximately 56% of revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q1 FY27, our warehousing sales was roughly at about 56%.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR 225 crores, up over 12.5% quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The large agriculture segment represents close to 20% of Uniparts' business at the end of FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: And what is the share of large ag in our business at the end of FY26, it's close to 20%.

orders_capacity.claim: Full-year FY26 sales mix by delivery channel was 51% warehousing, 26% direct exports, 14% India local, and 8% USA local.
orders_capacity.quote: Okay. So, I think if you look at the full year sales for FY26, the warehousing channel has given us about 51% of sales. Direct exports is about 26%. India local deliveries is about 14% and U.S.A. local deliveries is about 8%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's net cash position at the end of Q1 FY27 stood at INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts generated INR 44 crores in operating cash during Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital stood at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of June 30.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is evaluating roughly half a dozen acquisition opportunities across hydraulics, PTOs, and fabrications.
capital_allocation.quote: I think today, we have about half a dozen opportunities that we are closely looking at.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash position reached INR 190 crore at the end of Q1.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts India is actively evaluating acquisition opportunities to support its strategy.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts is net debt-free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR 170 crores, including a special dividend of INR 101 crores in Q3 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow was INR 52 crores for Q4 FY26 and INR 174 crores for full-year FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Operating cash flow was INR52 crores in Q4 and INR174 crores in FY26.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has exerted pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners to moderate aftermarket purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Large agricultural equipment industry is experiencing a trough in 2026 with an expected mid-teens decline.
risks_headwinds.quote: Large ag in '26 is facing its trough. We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Economic uncertainty and volatility have tempered consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing in the aftermarket.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred at the company's Ludhiana facility finishing shop towards the end of Q3 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fresh escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: FY27 revenue growth is targeted to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26 growth on a year-on-year basis.
management_commitments.quote: keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the fabrication vertical to become meaningful in the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: Warehousing sales are projected to remain in the 52% to 56% range over the next 12 to 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: So over a period of time, I think our warehousing sales will remain in the range of, let's say, about 52% to 55%, 56%. And I think that's where we foresee this to remain in the next, let's say, 12 to 18 months.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects first customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects FY27 growth to be in line with FY26 growth, supported by an improving industry cycle and new business wins.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: Sequentially, Q1 FY27 is expected to be in line with Q4 FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4.

management_commitments.claim: The second half of FY27 is expected to be stronger than the first half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

management_commitments.claim: Capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
management_commitments.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

management_commitments.claim: Efforts are underway to rebuild the Ludhiana plant's finishing shop and bring it online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Right. So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.timeframe: by the end of the year
